messages.subject: Re: Using wolfalps in parallel with foreach on hpc
messages.subject_clean: Using wolfalps in parallel with foreach on hpc
messages.body_plain: I had the opportunity to get some help from our HPC coordinator, and it turned out that the problem was due to compiler issues.. Changing from intel to foss compiled R packages seemed to solve the issues, at least for computation on one node. Thank you, though, for your input. I think it will be helpful if I need more nodes and I will definitely come back to it.
